summary: This class mostly covered subject content. For course logistics, it confirmed that Partial Exam 4 (Unit 5 - Physiology) will take place on Monday 2026-01-19 at the same time and requires synchronous connection; this matches the course page timing and adds the explicit synchronous requirement. It also informed students that this final session could run past 6 p.m. and that the recording would be uploaded for those who need to leave early, which is not on the course page.

items.title: Partial Exam 4 (Unit 5 - Physiology)
items.details: The second partial exam for this part of the subject will be next week, Monday 19 January 2026, at the same time. Students must be connected synchronously on that day.

items.title: Final session may run past 6 p.m. and be recorded
items.details: The teacher said this was the last session and it might last a little longer than 6 p.m. If students needed to leave early, the final minutes would be available in the automatically uploaded recording.
